title: No tsconfig includes scripts/ (or ignition/modules/ or test/), so the three CI type checks never compile the operator signing scripts; that is how the RC-27 scripts stayed broken unnoticed, and a signature change in src/bot.ts breaks deliberate-buy only when the operator runs it

evidence.note: "include": ["src"]; no forceConsistentCasingInFileNames and no isolatedModules, unlike tsconfig.json:8-9
the only type checks in CI use these two configs and the dashboard config

sibling_sites_checked: All three tsconfig files (dashboard/tsconfig.json is the DASH slice). ts-node type-checks a script when it is run (no transpile-only setting at the base), so a broken script fails before it signs; the gap is that nobody learns about it until then. The missing casing flag in tsconfig.bot.json is the RC-17 mitigation of plan 22-12 (AUD-TX-004); the test/ side is AUD-TESTU-008.
severity_rationale: S3: fails safe at run time (ts-node refuses before main runs), but the operator finds out only when a manual signing script is needed.
recommendation: Phase 26 (toolchain): add a tsconfig (or include entries) that covers scripts/ and ignition/modules/ and type-check it in CI; Phase 31 keeps it blocking.
